name: Southland Cross Country Championships
headline: Southland Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Stephen F. Austin won both Southland titles in Lake Charles. The SFA men scored 16 points to Texas A&M-Corpus Christi's 53, led by Eliud Kipkosgei's winning 23:31.36 with Paul Kiprotich second in 23:34.10. The SFA women scored 32 to Texas A&M-CC's 81, though Texas A&M-CC's Elizabeth Khatevi won the race in 18:53.56.
